messages:
todd_sales: Closed deal with Solstice Labs (midmarket). Passing to CS — highlights from final call:
- Wants Dedicated pool starting 2025-06-01, pilot month then convert to committed capacity
- SSO via Okta + SCIM, IP allowlist for egress
- Logs retention 90 days for compliance; SOC2 mention in contract
- Expected traffic ~2.2M tokens/day, mostly streaming chat; target p50 <350ms
- Requests 1-hour enablement for their infra + 30m product walkthrough

nina_csm: Thanks @todd_sales, I'll run the kickoff and owner the success plan. Scheduling pre-kick Tuesday 2025-05-06 9am PT. Owners:
- Customer kickoff & success plan: nina_csm
- Provisioning & billing: omar_cs_ops
- VPC peering & infra sizing: liam_eng
- Support runbook & oncall: anya_support

omar_cs_ops: Need from sales/customer asap:
1) CIDR for peering
2) PO/reference for reserved capacity
3) preferred model variants (we can default to redwood-7b-quant)
I'll open ticket once PO + CIDR in. Est provisioning ~8-10 business days after reqs complete.

liam_eng: For sizing, please upload a short sampling of streaming traces (curl) and expected concurrent streams. 4 GPUs OK to start if concurrency <35; otherwise bump.

anya_support: Ill draft the support runbook and SLA notes. Assign ticket to me when infra work starts. Also need their primary infra contact.

todd_sales: Contacts: "sara@solsticelabs.com" (infra), "devin@solsticelabs.com" (product). PO promised by EOD tomorrow.

ticket-bot: Created ticket CS-7621: "Solstice Labs dedicated provisioning" linked to infra queue. ETA auto: 2025-06-10.
